journeys.title: Signing in and out

moments.say: She tries to sign in a second time while still signed in, and is turned away.

journeys.goal: Alice wants to use the service and then leave it.

journeys.title: Locked out

moments.say: A wrong password is tried on her account.
A fourth. The account is still open.
The fifth wrong password locks the account and ends her session.
Alice tries to sign in again and is turned away.

journeys.goal: Someone tries wrong passwords on Alice's account while she is signed in.

journeys.title: Left idle

moments.say: And more: she has now been idle for three time units.
That is not yet long enough for the session to expire.
Back at her desk, Alice signs in again.

journeys.goal: Alice signs in and then walks away from her desk.

examples.text: The fifth failure locks the account
Four failures do not lock it
A session idle for four ticks expires
Three idle ticks are not enough to expire
A locked account cannot sign in
The lockout ends a signed-in user's session

code.setup:
from app.auth import AuthService
class Clock:
    now = 0
    def tick(self):
        self.now += 1
clock = Clock()
system = AuthService(lambda: clock.now)
